scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npx pkg . --output bin/gas-backend.exe --no-bytecode
scripts.bundle:windows: powershell -Command "$out='build/windows/x64/runner/Release/'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out; Copy-Item backend/bin/gas-backend.exe $out; Copy-Item backend/.env $out; Write-Host 'Backend artifacts bundled successfully.'"
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run bundle:windows && dart run msix:create
